what: Tapping the phone menu button slides a drawer (width 87.5%, max 400px) in from off the right in .45s ease, a blurred scrim fades in behind it in .5s, and document scroll locks. Tapping the ‹Sub level› button inside the drawer slides the two-panel strip left in .45s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) and the sub list stands, the back button returns. On close it folds back to the first level after 450ms. Tapping the scrim or pressing Esc also closes it

options.reset: Time until folding to the first step after closing (ms), default 450
options.[data-fx-part=track]: (if present) a panel holding two step columns side by side — first the menu, second the sub list
